research_question: I strongly believe the answer to the following question to be 'Yes'. Perform an analysis that verifies this. Does having children decrease (if at all) the engagement in extramarital affairs?

ivs.description: Are there children in the marriage? (factor indicating presence of children: 'yes'/'no').

dv.description: How often engaged in extramarital sexual intercourse during the past year (numeric coding: 0 = none, 1 = once, 2 = twice, 3 = 3 times, 7 = 4–10 times, 12 = monthly/weekly/daily aggregated as 12).

controls.description: factor indicating gender (used as a categorical control).
Age in years (coded categories: 17.5 = under 20, 22 = 20–24, …, 57 = 55 or over).
Number of years married (coded categories: e.g. 0.125, 0.417, 0.75, 1.5, 4, 7, 10, 15).
Self-reported religiousness (1 = anti, 2 = not at all, 3 = slightly, 4 = somewhat, 5 = very).
Education level coded numerically (9 = grade school, 12 = high school, 14 = some college, 16 = college graduate, 17 = some graduate work, 18 = master's, 20 = Ph.D./M.D./advanced).
Occupation code according to Hollingshead classification (numeric 1–7, reverse numbering).
Self-rating of marriage (1 = very unhappy, 2 = somewhat unhappy, 3 = average, 4 = happier than average, 5 = very happy).

import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv('affairs.csv')
    df['any_affair'] = (df['affairs'] > 0).astype(int)

    # Descriptive comparisons
    mean_by_children = df.groupby('children')['affairs'].mean()
    prop_any_by_children = df.groupby('children')['any_affair'].mean()

    print('Mean affairs by children:')
    print(mean_by_children)
    print('\nProportion with any affair by children:')
    print(prop_any_by_children)

    # Regression models with controls
    ols = smf.ols(
        'affairs ~ C(children) + age + yearsmarried + religiousness + education + occupation + rating + C(gender)',
        data=df,
    ).fit()
    logit = smf.logit(
        'any_affair ~ C(children) + age + yearsmarried + religiousness + education + occupation + rating + C(gender)',
        data=df,
    ).fit(disp=0)
    poisson = smf.poisson(
        'affairs ~ C(children) + age + yearsmarried + religiousness + education + occupation + rating + C(gender)',
        data=df,
    ).fit(disp=0)

    print('\nOLS coefficient for children=yes:')
    print(ols.params['C(children)[T.yes]'], 'p=', ols.pvalues['C(children)[T.yes]'])

    print('\nLogit coefficient for children=yes:')
    print(logit.params['C(children)[T.yes]'], 'p=', logit.pvalues['C(children)[T.yes]'])

    print('\nPoisson coefficient for children=yes:')
    print(poisson.params['C(children)[T.yes]'], 'p=', poisson.pvalues['C(children)[T.yes]'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
